subtitle.zh: Local Qwen Image 2.1 (7B DiT, INT8 / Turbo INT8) on an isolated ComfyUI: text-to-image, multi-reference editing, mask inpaint, native transparent background. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (8GB+ VRAM for INT8, 16GB+ recommended) and 40GB+ free disk.
subtitle.en: Local Qwen Image 2.1 (7B DiT, INT8 / Turbo INT8) on an isolated ComfyUI: text-to-image, multi-reference editing, mask inpaint, native transparent background. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (8GB+ VRAM for INT8, 16GB+ recommended) and 40GB+ free disk.

notes.zh: MTNode runs an isolated ComfyUI (127.0.0.1:8196) with the official native nodes (UNETLoader / CLIPLoader type=qwen_image / TextEncodeQwenImage21 / QwenImage21Cache / KSampler or SamplerCustomAdvanced / SetLatentNoiseMask). The qwenimage_gen canvas node mirrors the image-generation node: prompt, multi-reference editing, ratio buckets, gacha rolls, seed and mask inpaint; transparent background uses Qwen 2.1's native RGBA output (official prompt format, single pass). Both INT8 variants share one text encoder and one VAE. Licensed under the Qwen Research License; check the official terms before commercial use.
